findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router configured log_file '/opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl' does not exist (call_log_exists: false)

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and writes invocation logs to call_log.jsonl and directory permissions exist

findings.expected_benefit: Enables metric auditing, latency tracking, and failure visibility for model invocations

findings.title: Direct LLM API calls bypass model router in emergency alert summary

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral via GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY rather than querying the model router service

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the central model-router abstraction for consistent observability and fallback management

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model usage tracking, policy application, and prevents silent failure handling divergence
